build_with_constant_side_inputs: build a layer handler that provides constant side inputs to wrapped layers via a tag-to-value dictionary
build_with_side_inputs_from_input_tuple: build a layer handler that unpacks side inputs from a tuple argument and passes them to the wrapped body
hoist_constant_side_inputs: hoist constant side inputs from a tree so they can be re-handled by WithConstantSideInputs
create_side_input_request: create a side input request with a unique tag for requesting a side input inside a layer
create_handled_side_input_ref: create a handled side input reference that resolves a side input request to its implementation
